experiment.control: Primary control is the attested AV-off k5 service. Mechanism comparators are unchanged installed AV and a legal fixed verification-prefix policy selected on development states and locked before validation; all retain k5 proposals. Joint-state comparisons use identical confidence arrays, context, request membership and cost observations. Corrected AV must outperform AV-off, not merely stock AV.
experiment.correctness: Preserve relevant G01-G05 and Q01-Q04 requirements; their complete definitions are missing and remain a prerequisite. Test zero/intermediate/full budgets, lengths 1-6, empty/dummy ranks, cross-rank disagreement, graph boundaries, compaction/reallocation, stale-confidence buffers, token ownership, EOS, cancellation and recovery. Verify real probabilistic rejection, watermark behavior and exact token accounting with common-input distribution/verifier fixtures. Sampling acceptance is diagnostic, not a quality score. No C03 code is silently introduced.
experiment.cost: All figures are prospective allocations, not measured effort; this response uses zero engineering execution and zero GPU-hours. Inspection/offline pilot: estimated 4-8 engineering hours, cap 8; GPU 0. Implementation/correctness: effort unknown until feasibility inspection; provisional estimate 16-32 engineering hours, cap 32 including an initial 8-hour checkpoint; CPU GPU usage 0, GPU correctness charged within the pilot below. Instrumentation/pilot operation and analysis: estimated 8-16 engineering hours, cap 16; GPU ceiling 24 hours across three 60-minute eight-GPU slots. Each slot includes startup, calibration/capture, warmup, measurement, export and cleanup. Historical cold startup was about 26 minutes; new calibration and capture costs are unknown. Stop at the slot cap. Separate conditional screen: 3-6 engineering hours, cap 6, two 75-minute node slots=20 GPU-hours. Confirmation: 6-12 engineering hours, cap 12, ten 75-minute slots=100 GPU-hours. Held-out allowance: 2-4 engineering hours, cap 4, two 75-minute slots=20 GPU-hours. No retries included; correctness needing more resources causes deferral. At full-node price P/hour, cost is P times allocated GPU-hours/8. Price and service cost-per-token savings remain unknown.
experiment.held_out_condition: Select policies on development states only. Hold out long-context, ragged DP, mixed prefill/decode and cold/warm states. Preserve native agent-f75 8K/1K and full fixed-schedule Mooncake anchors at seq64. Keep 1K/1K cache-isolated traffic diagnostic; seq128 is a separate configuration.
experiment.inconclusive_if: Offline work cannot explain the association failures, required native coverage remains absent, runtime confidence is unavailable, joint decisions cannot be reconstructed, timing boundaries overlap ambiguously, or the interval crosses the materiality threshold. Resource-cap exhaustion, unstable curves and excessive instrumentation perturbation also defer advancement. No automatic replacement capture or AV-on campaign follows.
experiment.metrics: Joint policy disagreement and descriptor frequencies; all-rank eligible cycles and categorized busy union; target compute, communication, draft, sampler and controller occupied times; replica dependency-chain elapsed time; committed accepted-plus-bonus output tokens; confidence residuals; added synchronization. Predeclare matched replay blocks containing the same joint-state sequence, alternating policy order. Compute block-level exposed time per committed token, retaining differences in progress. Record exact tokens, request joins, draft/verify/accepted deltas, missing/reset counters, KV/preemption and replay lag. Later retain frozen ITL separately from request TPOT=(last-first token time)/(server output tokens-1), TTFT/E2E tails, goodput and quality.
experiment.rejects_if: Stop the scoped correction for an already equivalent objective, incompatible backend behavior, correctness failure, or required coordination exceeding feasibility scope. With adequate measurements, stop allocation if AV-off or the locked static policy is at least as good after progress and overhead, or if the upper uncertainty bound on the opportunity proxy is below 2%. This rejects the correction or its allocation value, not every possible AV policy.
experiment.supports_if: Offline work establishes a missing, reachable cost dependency and a deployable state-access design. GPU adequacy requires valid launch associations, both graph paths, at least ten complete decode-only cycles per rank/window and at least 95% categorized device-busy union; the old gate is not weakened. Use twelve prospectively fixed paired replay blocks as technical measurement units, with a 95% block-resampled interval; these are not independent service runs. Advancement requires correctness, positive lower-bound net exposed savings against every comparator, and a conservative native-frequency/progress calculation reaching a 2% opportunity proxy. That proxy is not a predicted median ITL gain. Full service selection remains separate: positive frozen screen, both 3% tail guards, at least five alternating matched full-run confirmation pairs for small gains, and the existing 2% promotion requirement.
experiment.treatment: Cheapest decision pilot: an eight-engineering-hour offline cap, zero GPU-hours, covering equivalent-feature inspection, trace-reader fixtures and joint-rank dispatch reconstruction. Missing traces/source remain pending rather than presumed inspected. Before any GPU release, independently review a concrete instrumentation addendum: explicit native-cycle identities, validated correlation schema, device-boundary timing compatible with existing stream dependencies, and capture termination based on complete native cycles rather than profiler-step count. Proposed captures request 40 complete decode cycles per rank in each fixed window, with a 30-second window cap and no post-result window shifts. Buffer/export scheduling must avoid the former bracket contamination. Conditional future GPU ceiling: one 60-minute baseline qualification slot; only if adequate, two additional 60-minute control/AV-harness slots. Total 180 minutes on eight allocated GPUs, 24 GPU-hours, no retries. The harness compares stock, coupled and locked-static policies on matched joint states; it is not a service frontier run.
